qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve sleepy curly-haired developer, purple T-shirt, gray sweatpants, navy cat slippers, beige cracked CRT and cables. Review CRT facial icon, giant pixel wrench repair, connectors and title readability.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact tired brown-skinned adult man with messy black curls, faint chin stubble, heavy-lidded eyes, loose purple T-shirt, gray drawstring sweatpants and navy slippers with cream sleeping-cat faces. Preserve his old beige CRT monitor with cracked glass, tiny pixel sad-face icon and loose black cables. Do not replace it with a laptop. No code listings or other readable screen text.
0–0.7s: full-body view. He looks exhausted, balances the cracked CRT against his shoulder and gives its side one impatient open-palm thump. The little sad-face icon abruptly changes to a determined square face.
0.7–2.5s: the screen erupts into a COLOSSAL gold-and-magenta pixel-built socket wrench on a segmented mechanical arm, thrusting thirty feet into depth toward a broken gold shield emblem. Camera shoots alongside it as big finite pixel blocks click together. The wrench grabs the emblem's separated pieces, spins one enormous quarter-turn and slams them together into a perfectly repaired shield with a thunderous mechanical CLONK and explosive warm-white/gold pixel shockwave. Strong readable repair impact and impossible tool scale. Device, pixels and shield are foreground props against pure cyan; no background screen rectangle, room, desk or fullscreen digital filter.
2.5–3.5s: snap back to the developer as the giant wrench folds into the CRT in a rapid series of satisfying chunky clicks. The repaired shield shrinks to a small glowing token beside him. Exact title WORKS ON MY MACHINE slams in three clear comic lines below his face.
3.5–5s: he raises one weary approving thumb. The screen's tiny face becomes smug for a beat, then one little puff of warm-gray smoke escapes the monitor. He immediately lowers his thumb and side-eyes the screen without moving his body. Hold the complete figure, cat slippers, CRT and stable title. SFX: hollow plastic thump, startup click, enormous ratcheting tool rush, metallic repair CLONK, pixel snap-retraction and tiny exhausted smoke pfft. No speech, music or real operating-system jingles.

qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve red-shirted chef, white/red paper hat, cream apron with red fist, black trousers, white shoes, chopsticks and sushi tray. Remove embedded backdrop remnants. Review six-piece serving continuity and no cyan-tinted steam.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact adult male chef with tousled black hair, narrow mustache and pointed chin beard, white paper cook's hat with red stripe, short-sleeve red collared shirt, cream apron with a small red FIST emblem, black trousers and white slip-on work shoes. Preserve wooden chopsticks and the black clear-lidded supermarket sushi tray, salmon orange, ivory rice and dark olive seaweed. No crowns, new signs, words, shop scenery or background stripes from the reference.
0–0.7s: full-body confident pose. He flashes the sushi tray toward the viewer with a knowing smirk, then hooks the chopsticks under the lid of one small ivory cooler with a red lid floating beside him.
0.7–2.5s: the cooler bursts open and launches one ENORMOUS complete sushi roll thirty feet upward, a spiraling cylinder of ivory rice, dark olive nori and salmon-orange filling. Camera yanks upward and far back to reveal its scale. He leaps after it with apron billowing and gives one impossibly fast, decisive chopstick scissor-sweep. The giant roll splits cleanly into six massive circular pieces in a spectacular radial arrangement, with a huge orange-and-ivory impact star and a sharp contact hold. Camera races through the gaps as all six pieces shrink and descend toward his waiting tray. Strong physical food forms, finite rice grains and cream ink-outlined cold-vapor curls; no cyan or turquoise liquid, no floor, shop or fullscreen whiteout.
2.5–3.5s: snap back to full-body service pose. The six normal-sized pieces land in the black tray in a rapid satisfying cascade as he clicks its clear lid shut. Exact title TRUST THE COOLER slams below his face in two bold comic lines.
3.5–5s: he proudly offers the tray; one sushi piece gives a suspicious little wobble under the clear lid. He taps it once with a chopstick, holds a perfectly innocent smile and nudges the cooler closed with his shoe. Keep his face, fist apron emblem, shoes and text readable. SFX: plastic lid click, enormous cold-air whoosh, rising food rush, crisp giant slicing WHACK, six quick soft serving taps and tiny final cooler click. No voice or music.

choreography:
IDENTITY: exact athletic young adult Black man with short parted locs, neat goatee, small gold hoop earring, camouflage bib overalls over a white tank, tan work boots and the same small Haitian flag patch. 3.5–5s: he calmly scratches under the gator's chin. It closes its eyes blissfully; the flattened tire slips from its mouth and makes one embarrassingly tiny rubber squeak. SFX: throw whoosh, rushing torpedo air, thunderous jaw CLACK with rubber compression, rolling wind, heavy return thump, contented low gator rumble and final tiny squeak. No human voice or music.
